notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows only specific path patterns (paginated /c/*page_*/, /c/*home-*ecor/, furniture type_ query combos, luxury-lighting, image tools, etc) and does not name anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot, so tier (c) was permitted. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl + curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) returned an identical 1119-byte 'Site Maintenance / LampsPlus_CPR_Block' anti-bot block page on every URL tried, including the homepage and sitemap-derived category pages -> first-block-stops-you, moved to tier (b). Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium hit the exact same CPR_Block page (same block, confirmed not tier-specific to curl). Moved to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome: real browser session passed a 'Powered and protected by [Cloudflare]' interstitial challenge automatically and loaded live rendered pages normally thereafter for the rest of the session. All data below was read from tier (c) rendered DOM text. TREE: built from union of sitemap-category.xml (200 URLs fetched via tier-a, parsed with grep before the block was discovered) + the site's own mega-menu (Home Accessories vs Furniture split, confirmed via /home-decor/ nav) + each category page's own breadcrumb/h1. Lamps Plus is a lighting-first retailer; its only textile-relevant nodes are Rugs (standalone top nav category) and three Home Accessories sub-types (Bedding, Throw Pillows, Decorative Pillows) reached via /c/home-accessories/type_*/ URLs, each independently confirmed by matching breadcrumb + h1 + canonical path. QTY: taken verbatim from each page's rendered 'N results' header text (e.g. '3,045 results', '113 results') - none estimated or aggregated. EXCLUDED: /c/cabinets-and-storage/ (1,775 results) and its /location_outdoor/ child (16 results) were investigated as Storage candidates but excluded - the site itself titles and markets this entire branch as 'Storage Furniture' / 'Decorative Cabinets - Furniture for the Organized Home', and its contents are accent cabinets, nightstands, consoles, bookcases, vanities, wine carts, and (outdoor) storage benches/screens/serving carts - all Furniture per storage.md Sec21/27 (site explicitly places them in a Furniture category) so none were recorded as Storage. /c/home-accessories/type_boxes/ (69 results, 'Decorative Boxes') excluded as Decorative Home Accessories per storage.md Sec23/24 - page is jewelry/trinket/keepsake boxes framed as decorative, not general home storage. /c/home-accessories/ itself (10,120 results, wall art/sculptures/vases/clocks/candles/orchids) and /c/home-accessories/location_outdoor/ were not recorded since they are mixed Decorative-Home-Accessories catch-alls whose qualifying textile children are already captured individually (Bedding, Throw Pillows, Decorative Pillows). No dedicated Storage/Organization category exists anywhere in the nav or sitemap. Duplicate check: Throw Pillows and Decorative Pillows are two genuinely distinct navigable subcategory URLs (different breadcrumb h1, different result counts 359 vs 223) despite some product overlap between the two facets, so both were kept per the site's own hierarchy - not treated as duplicates.
